Resolves #21372

`dev`'s engine e2e shard 8 failed twice on the two #20627 pending-start arms in `HeaderGroups.spec.mjs`. Both arms went from the order poll straight to the next `dragGroup`, which measures Q2 while the drop may still be re-rendering the group cells. The CI traces show both outcomes: a cell briefly gone (`:825`) and a drop one slot off (`:831`). The arms now wait with `expectRelaidOut(page)` between the gestures, as every sibling drag test in the file already does. #21364's shard 8 then caught a third outcome of the same race. Right after the second drag's order settled, a one-shot read found the drop's own proxy still fading out (`:833`). The #20627 checks for a leftover proxy now poll for it; a stale proxy never goes away, so the check keeps its force.

Evidence: L3 (the whole spec in local Chromium, twice) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-3). Residual: none; AC-2's reproduction is reported below as not reachable with this instrument.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderGroups.spec.mjs`, both "… during a group drag's pending start …" arms now `await expectRelaidOut(page)` before the next drag |
| AC-2 | outside-CI: not reproduced. With CDP CPU throttling at 6× and 15× (the hook verified by a bad rate, which failed the test), the unfixed arms passed 8/8 at each rate. CDP throttles the page's main thread only, not the App and VDom workers whose re-render races the measurement, so this instrument narrows the race instead of widening it. The two CI traces remain the evidence of the race |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: this PR's engine e2e |

## Deltas from ticket

- AC-2's reproduction is not reachable with CPU throttling, for the reason above. The fix rests on the CI traces and on the file's own wait between gestures.

## Test Evidence

- `HeaderGroups.spec.mjs` with `--repeat-each=2`: 48 passed locally after the first commit. The #20627 arms with `--repeat-each=3`: 21 passed at the head.

- `b3dc5a4c56`: the #20627 checks for a leftover proxy poll instead of reading once
